Morning Brief · Monday, Oct 7, 2026 · composed by Point Conductor at 05:58 ET

Overnight: tokenized semis gapped down. CPI tomorrow. Trim semis before open.

What changed overnight

Tokenized NVDA, AMD and SMH traded −2.3% to −2.9% on weekend venues (xStocks, Ondo). Options skew on SMH is now the steepest in 60 days. BTC funding spiked to +0.082%, open interest +18%, consistent with crowded longs — COIN and MSTR exposure at risk Monday.

Agent findings

  • Risk Beta-net projected 63.1% at open vs. IMA cap 60%. Trim NVDA 12% + SMH Nov 215/205 put spread.
  • Macro CPI tomorrow 08:30 ET. Hot-print scenario (+0.4% MoM core) = −38 bps NAV. Suggest ladder: 10Y DV01 hedge 0.6× book.
  • Flows Research universe: ADSK crowding 90 (institutions 100%). 17 of the bottom-20 shorts already have short interest ≥ 8% — GPRO 18.4%, and Blackrock added 4.3 pts of it.
  • Earnings JPM reports Thu — supplier read-across for V, MA. Tone model suggests cautious guidance (confidence 71%).
  • Digital Tokenized AAPL basis −1.9%; arb desk could add; depth thin on Securitize.
  • PnL MSFT contributing −24 bps MTD · alpha half-life expired, flagged for trim.
  • Pos Intel NVDA thesis drift ↑: insider sales $220M + activist 13D (Elliot).

The three decisions for today

  1. Approve the Risk & Guideline card trimming NVDA 12%. Alpha cost 6bps, headroom restored, IMA clean.
  2. Layer CPI hedge via Macro agent ladder. Pre-trade what-if shows <2bps carry.
  3. On the market sleeve, ADSK is the de-gross name (crowding 90). The research shorts are already crowded — GPRO short interest 18.4%.
